desc: Implement fixed-\(L\) DP with correct initialization, keep/flip transitions, and minimum-flip extraction.
Add binary search over \(L \in [1,n]\), using monotonic feasibility.
Verify the implementation on all examples and edge cases, including \(L=1\), \(numOps=0\), and already-valid strings.
Confirm \(O(n^2)\) total feasibility work across binary search and \(O(n)\) space are acceptable for \(n \le 1000\).
